As a medical oncologist, I am dedicated to providing the best possible care for pets with cancer. I am a board-certified veterinary oncologist with 15+ years of experience in the diagnosis and treatment of various types of cancer in dogs and cats. I strive to offer the most effective and compassionate treatments for your pet, while also supporting you through this difficult time. If your pet has been diagnosed with cancer, I am here to help!
Contact me today to schedule a consultation.
